conditions: Submit an Exit Notice form; within 14 days a Billing Support agent is assigned.
After that, a 30-day Initiation Period to start migrating, then a Migration Period of at least 30 days (extendable).
"You are not eligible for the free data transfer program if you are not terminating your agreement for the relevant Google Cloud services."

Submit a Completion Notice after the Migration Period (max 180 days after it ends); termination follows after at least 30 days.
